hold_text: Promotes RQ-20260930-504 (general short-timeframe strategy discovery, 5m/15m/30m; pre-registered, nothing run) into the queue and ships its instrument scripts/research/short_tf_discovery_sweep.py with 27 tests. Addresses the independent review of #14586: the runner now fetches its own candles (--fetch, Binance-vision futures/um via fetch_backtest_candles.py; a failed fetch makes the cell unrunnable and a mostly-unfetched grid is NOT_APPLICABLE), needs_trainer_resident_data is false, the timeout is 330 with --jobs 3, live-config cells are flagged stage_b_not_fully_oos and a PASS carried only by them is PASS_CAVEATED, a shortened Stage B is a smoke run. The operator's 1m request is registered as its own blocked grid RQ-20260930-505 (a 1m frame does not fit the runner's cap; its own K and S). Held for the manager: a new queue unit is a registration and must merge before any run. General research mandate (not venue-specific). No config or runtime change. Also: verdict.json now uses the research-result collector's closed vocabulary (measured read_state, integer n = K, pass/fail/no_action_warranted/indeterminate/not_applicable; PASS_CAVEATED is a pass with the caveat first in note), verified by running the real script_run.derive_record over every verdict path; a first version would have landed producer_failed exactly as RQ-20260930-501 did.
why: Operator request 2026-09-30: add a research unit to strategy development to look for profitable shorter-timeframe strategies; clarified as a general research mandate, not HyroTrader-specific.
